name: Santo Tomé de Zabarcos (Spain)
description: A green hoist third bearing three yellow ears of wheat, the fly compony of red and white in four squares, the red squares charged with yellow towers.
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 3 June 2005 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 139 of 19 July 2005); the flag is of dimensions 2:3, tierced at the hoist in green with three ears of wheat, the fly compony of red and white with the red squares charged with a yellow tower.

features.role: fly compony of red and white with yellow towers on the red
